arguments.Title: 차량 토글 선택과 센서 OFF 검증
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; using Unity.Cinemachine; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { Application.runInBackground=true; var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); if(hud==null) throw new System.Exception("HUD not loaded"); foreach(var t in hud.GetComponentsInChildren<Toggle>()) if(t.name=="Select V01") { result.Log("allowSwitchOff="+t.group.allowSwitchOff+" initial="+t.isOn); t.isOn=true; result.Log("selected="+hud.OperatorControls.SelectedVehicle.OperatorVehicleId+" following="+hud.OperatorControls.IsFollowing); } var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); result.Log("observation="+c.LatestObservationJson); foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<CinemachineBrain>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) result.Log("brain="+b.enabled+" camera="+b.ActiveVirtualCamera?.Name); } }
